0022600212.text: The 76ers (9-2, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East, on a W1 streak after a 8-2 last ten) host the Celtics (8-2, 2nd in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, on a W3 streak) in their 12th game of the season. Philadelphia will be without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), and Dominick Barlow (back fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the 76ers won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, including a 109-100 win in Boston on May 2, 2026.
